evals.prompt: Compile a new product idea. The immediate decision is only how to classify the request and identify the first interview gaps.
Resume a compiled project after major context compaction. PROJECT_INDEX and compact STATE exist and point to the current requirement.
Generate only contracts/PRODUCT_REALIZATION.yaml using the compiled model.
Generate contracts/APP_FLOW.yaml for an already-modeled lifecycle.
The product capability envelope is known. Resolve master systems and composition before producing SYSTEM_MAP.
A second same-type catalog item should appear through the existing generic detail surface. Check the reusable definition model.
Audit whether current evidence supports a claimed milestone; no user-surface claim is being made.
The claim is that the final normal-user surface matches its approved design and interaction requirements.
During compilation a reusable cross-system capability owner is ambiguous and must be resolved before freezing architecture.
Refactor APC plugin references to reduce context cost without changing compiler semantics.
A stale internal link points to RUNTIME_TEMPLATES.md after v2.35.
The best JIT decomposition requires more than twenty supporting reference files but each has a distinct material trigger.
A fresh agent must reconstruct the complete compiled project while APC references remain JIT.
A turn needs interview closure first, then an architecture owner decision, then one acceptance artifact.
Resolve a project-local specialist Skill requirement; no APC package-maintenance decision is involved.

The APC root router names a canonical JIT reference, but skills__read returns Resource not found immediately after a plugin update. Account-plugin source readback shows the file exists in the current release.
Compile a portable binary distribution whose runnable package root must not contain extra compiler metadata and which has no Git repository.
An existing project already has a canonical responsibility/owner map from another procedure. APC needs the System/Owner semantic role for its package.
An autonomous compile has reconstructed the project and all reachable evidence, but one consequential user-owned interpretation cannot be answered without the user. Its impact is explicitly bounded.
Compile a small coherent project whose vision, decisions, owner map and acceptance can remain unambiguous in a compact authority set. Existing external authorities already cover some roles.

A project already has a canonical durable goal authority with the observable master outcome, scope, acceptance IDs and completion condition. APC binds it instead of duplicating GOAL.md. A weaker implementation agent has passed its first milestone and is about to stop, while required product outcomes remain unverified.

A project's planned expansion relies on an unverified claim that its current approach works on representative inputs. A small pilot can test that claim; separate interface work does not depend on it. Compile the plan and acceptance boundary without inventing a user decision.
